title: Jad model.json
description: Session model and provider configuration. Secrets are referenced through an environment variable name, never stored here. A file that fails these rules is left out of the models a session offers, with a warning in the server log, and the other models still load; this holds for a profile's model_default too, which is never replaced by another model: a run that would use a model that is left out stops with the file's error.

name.description: Display name of the model, shown beside its ID in the catalog editor. Changes no behavior; defaults to the ID.

provider.description: Provider identifier, for example openai or openrouter.

api.description: Protocol of the provider. responses calls {base_url}/responses. anthropic_messages and chat_completions are translated in jad's own process, with no separate adapter to run: anthropic_messages calls the Anthropic Messages API ({base_url}/v1/messages, base_url defaults to https://api.anthropic.com, api_key_env to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) with the settings in anthropic; chat_completions calls an OpenAI-compatible {base_url}/chat/completions (vLLM, Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, DeepSeek, Groq, gateways; base_url defaults to https://api.openai.com/v1) with the settings in chat_completions. Both need no hosted_tools.

base_url.description: Provider base URL. For api responses the OpenAI-compatible SDK base URL, without the /responses path; for chat_completions the root /chat/completions is appended to (for example http://localhost:11434/v1); for anthropic_messages the Anthropic API root, without /v1 (for example https://api.anthropic.com).

api_key_env.description: Environment variable containing the provider API key. The key is always read from this variable; signing in with a ChatGPT subscription (auth_mode openai_oauth) was removed.

auth_mode.description: api_key reads the key from api_key_env; it is the only mode and the key may be left out. The value openai_oauth (ChatGPT subscription sign-in) and the key oauth_auth_file were removed and are refused with an error that says to use an API key; they are never read as an API key session.

request.description: Additional Responses API generation options. The session runner owns model, input, instructions, stream, and tools.

instructions.description: Not allowed. Put the text in the profile's instructions: a model file is shared by every profile, so it is written once there. A model file that has the key fails to load.

prompt_cache_key.description: session sends every request of a session with the same prompt_cache_key (OpenAI Responses), so the provider routes them to the same prompt cache and long sessions hit it more often. The key is jad- and a digest of the session's transcript path (plus the agent name for a sub-agent, so the children of one agent share a key); it holds no path or name. Needs api responses, and cannot be combined with request.prompt_cache_key, which sends a fixed key. off sends no key. Off by default because a Responses-compatible server other than OpenAI may refuse the field.

pricing.description: What the model costs, in US dollars per million tokens. With it, every response of the model is priced from the usage it reports: cached input tokens (input_tokens_details.cached_tokens) at cached_input_per_mtok, cache writes the Anthropic translation reports (input_tokens_details.cache_creation_5m_tokens and cache_creation_1h_tokens; a cache_creation_tokens total without the split counts as 5-minute writes) at cache_write_per_mtok and cache_write_1h_per_mtok, the rest of input_tokens at input_per_mtok, output_tokens (reasoning included) at output_per_mtok. Usage events and jad run report cost_usd, jad eval sums it, and max_run_cost_usd can cap a run. Absent: the model's cost is unknown and nothing is reported. Prices change: copy them from the provider's price list.

cache_write_per_mtok.description: Input written to a prompt cache with the 5-minute lifetime (Anthropic: 1.25x the input price). Defaults to input_per_mtok.

cache_write_1h_per_mtok.description: Input written with the 1-hour lifetime (Anthropic: 2x the input price). Defaults to cache_write_per_mtok.

efforts.description: Reasoning efforts a run may choose by writing the model as "<category>/<name>@<effort>" (the run body, a subagent's model, or a profile's model_default; a profile's models list plain IDs). The chosen value replaces request.reasoning.effort for that run; without @ the request is used as written. An effort not listed here is refused. Absent or empty: the model has no choice and "@<effort>" is refused.

hosted_tools.description: Provider-side tool definitions sent after the function tools, for example [{"type": "web_search"}]. The provider runs them, so there is no tool code here; each object is passed on unchanged. Needs api responses: the Anthropic and Chat Completions translations serve function tools only.

type.description: Hosted tool type. function is refused; function tools come from the tool catalog.

anthropic.description: Settings of the Anthropic translation, for api anthropic_messages only. The keys of anthropic-adapter.schema.json (thinking and effort per model, prompt caching, stream_retry, extra_body, log, ...). listen and caller_token_env (keys of the removed standalone adapter command) are refused because nothing listens, and so is upstream.base_url, which is this file's base_url. Absent means the adapter's defaults, with one exception: when no cache object is set, prompt caching is on, with breakpoints on the tools, the system prompt and the last conversation block (cache {"tools": true, "system": true, "history": true}, 5-minute lifetime), because an agent resends the same prefix every round. A cache object replaces that default as a whole: {} turns caching off. Price cache writes with pricing.cache_write_per_mtok. upstream.credential_file and upstream.expiry_margin_ms (the Claude subscription sign-in) were removed and are refused with an error that says to use an API key.

chat_completions.description: Settings of the Chat Completions translation, for api chat_completions only. Absent means these defaults. The request carries model, messages, tools, tool_choice, parallel_tool_calls, temperature, top_p, the max tokens field, reasoning_effort (from request.reasoning.effort), response_format (from request.text.format), user and stream; other Responses fields (store, include, metadata, prompt_cache_key, ...) are dropped.

max_tokens_field.description: Field that carries request.max_output_tokens: max_completion_tokens (OpenAI's current name) or max_tokens (older servers).

include_usage.description: Send stream_options.include_usage so the stream ends with token counts. Set false for a server that refuses stream_options; usage is then reported as zero.

system_role.description: Role of the instructions and of system or developer messages.

reasoning_fields.description: Delta fields read as reasoning text, first match wins. reasoning_content: DeepSeek, vLLM, llama.cpp; reasoning: OpenRouter, Ollama. Empty reads none.

echo_reasoning_field.description: When set, the text of a reasoning item in the history is sent on the next assistant message under this field (reasoning_content for DeepSeek's thinking mode with tool calls). Empty drops reasoning from the history.

missing_tool_result_text.default: No result was recorded for this tool call.
missing_tool_result_text.description: Tool message sent for a call the history has no result for: Chat Completions refuses an unanswered tool call.

request_timeout_ms.description: Longest one upstream call may take, stream included.

max_event_bytes.description: Largest upstream SSE event (or non-streaming answer); a larger one fails the response.

max_request_bytes.description: Largest Responses request the translation accepts.

extra_headers.description: Headers added to every upstream request (for example HTTP-Referer for OpenRouter). Authorization, Content-Type, Content-Length, Host and Accept are refused.

extra_body.description: Top-level fields merged last into every request body, as written (for example {"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": true}} for vLLM). model, messages, tools, tool_choice, stream and stream_options are refused.
